title: Forward inline string storage swap
summary: Recovered cdecl helper at VA 0x451d10: exchange 16 bytes in forward order, preserving overlap behavior and equal-pointer/unsigned end-wrap early returns. Caller at 0x451bac selects inline storage when both capacities are below 16; size and capacity are untouched. Original instructions and caller were inspected directly in Game.exe and accepted assembly. Ghidra import was attempted but failed with a database File too large error.
test_description: Direct original_narrow_inline_swap comparison for 8712 patterned overlap/equality/adjacency cases plus distant storage, checking all 128 bytes and untouched guards including trailing metadata. Disjoint cases additionally assert exact exchange. Invalid equal pointers and all 16 first-pointer wrap cases verify no access; no-access calls are followed by full-buffer comparison. Native MSVC2013 implementation compilation is additionally checked at O1, O2 and O2 with frame pointers; this does not replace behavioral validation or confer matching credit.
known_limits: Non-early-return paths require both 16-byte regions accessible; invalid dereferences and second-region address wrap are not tested.
Original has no defined return value; caller-clobbered registers and flags are not exposed as C++ outputs.
Address wrap follows uintptr width on a port; differential validation targets the original 32-bit ABI.
Ghidra database import failed under sandbox file-size limits; instruction and caller analysis used original executable disassembly.
